The current feature set (see CHANGELOG) is implemented and covered by uni"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"t tests, but cross-version compatibility beyond the development environment is not yet certified."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The core idea"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Open a Markdown file — it **is** a mindmap.
- The chat is not the main character; it is the assist"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ant that edits the mindmap next to you.
- You say one sentence, the AI edits the `.md` one step, the"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" panel follows instantly.
- Mindmap = Markdown: diffable, shareable, and git-friendly by nature."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Four tools** (`mindmap_create` / `mindmap_open` / `mindmap_get` / `mindmap_update`) — plain Mark"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"down files in the session working directory; the root node title is the filename and stays in sync b"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"oth ways (`renameRoot` renames the file, collisions are rejected).
- **Live panel with zero extra ch"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"annels** — the panel consumes the session snapshot (`mindmap_*` tool results), so every AI edit re-r"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"enders immediately.
- **Reliable open, recoverable loading state** — AI create/open results always e"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"xpand the panel (a structural-fingerprint selector drives snapshot recomputation even when the host "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"reuses the nodes array reference); clicking a `.md` first reads it through the local read-only route"},{"id":"p9s8","text":", while AI fallback loading still recovers from case-only path mismatches, inline tool errors, and a"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" ~30s watchdog timeout with one-click retry.
- **Refresh from disk** — 刷新脑图 reloads the current file"},{"id":"p9s10","text":" while preserving drafts and attachments, without submitting a model request. Fresh disk content sta"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"ys visible until a later tool result arrives; overlapping reads, closing, and session changes cannot"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" let an old request replace the new view. Failed refreshes retain the canvas and show a retryable er"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"ror.
- **Draft protection** — uses the host's published input snapshot for text, references, and att"},{"id":"p9s14","text":"achments. Pending or unreadable input is preserved; files still open through the read-only route and"},{"id":"p9s15","text":" editing commands remain available for manual submission.
- **Graceful parse failure** — if a docume"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"nt's Markdown ever breaks the parser, the panel never crashes: the mindmap area shows an explicit pa"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"rse-failed state with the error, the original file is left untouched, and you can switch back to the"},{"id":"p9s18","text":" directory tab or let the AI fix the content and reopen.
